description: The 2026-09-08 gamma-gamma ruling decides the nucleon braid ORDERING that #7188 identified as owed. Of the census's two models only the interleaved one has a gamma-gamma-produced core -- (sigma_0 sigma_1^-1)^3 is three pair-production vertices, while the gen-grouped core carries a positive crossing in second position, which no vertex concatenation produces (sorry-free, no axioms). The ruled order's residual is -17.4959 % against the gen-grouped -15.4514 %: the derivation costs 2.04 points, which is the correct trade under NO FITTING.

data.markov_convention: D — the ruled functional, z_D = q^3/(q^2+1)

caveats: 🛑 EVERY PERCENTAGE HERE IS ON THE ORDER-ZERO E_0 (m_e/(q(q-1)) = 4.18598136 MeV). `173da443b6` on main made the TOWER-SUMMED form canonical (4.22748336 MeV, +0.9915 %), and this probe's E_0 is inherited from qbeta_option_e_order_dof_range_probe, which that commit did not migrate. On the canonical base the two rows are -16.67794 % and -14.613128 % (CHECK 7). The order-zero figures are kept as the PRIMARY ones because the corpus cells they are compared against -- delta_S's -43.157 %, #7188's -15.4514 % -- were computed there; mixing bases is exactly the silent-revert trap of docs/audits/2026-09-12-zd-gap-anatomy... §6. The RANKING is invariant to the base (CHECK 7), so no conclusion here depends on which is used.

🛑 THE RULED ORDER IS THE LESS ACCURATE ONE. -17.4959 % against -15.4514 %. Do NOT prefer the gen-grouped figure because it is closer -- that is selection against the target, which AGENTS.md NO FITTING names explicitly. The 2.04 points are the price of the order no longer being an unstated modelling choice.

The -15.4514 % that #7188 and #7212 calibrate against is the GEN-GROUPED (unruled) order. Nothing there is retracted -- both state their ordering -- but the CANONICAL residual under the ruling is -17.4959 %, and this witness is the record of which figure is which.

🛑 TRAP. 'Interleaved' reconstructed by zipping the two _GEN_CHAINS lists alternately gives -13.5712 %, which is NEITHER census model. The census's interleaved model emits the core as three (sigma_0, sigma_1^-1) pairs, then an ORDERED quark block, then two gluon letters. Reproducing the documented -17.496 % is the calibration that catches a lookalike reconstruction.

Scope: (b) on the EXCLUSION -- it cites a proved invariant (a gamma-gamma word's second letter is negative), not a bad number. (a) on the RESIDUALS -- two census models at one pin. The ruling constrains the CORE; the flavour and gluon letters are not gamma-gamma words and their placement is not settled here.

THE PARITY BOUND IS A LIMIT ON THE RULING, not a defect in it. The crossing budget is 11 (odd) and every gamma-gamma word has even length, so NO 11-crossing word is gamma-gamma-produced -- for any candidate, in any order. The principle settles the 6-letter core and provably cannot settle the other 5. Do not read this as the construction failing to apply the ruling.
#7212's 3.13x gap result is UNAFFECTED: it prices differences of vertex powers V^k, a gamma-gamma-only construction that contains no nucleon ordering at all.
